      Amazon Customer
      5 out of 5 stars
      A great value buy, especially on Prime Day!
      I got this phone after using the Samsung Galaxy S9 Plus for nearly 3.5 years. That phone had a battery that was draining fast and also developed a tiny spot on one edge of the screen. I wanted a near-flagship level phone since I was used to the great performance on the S9 plus. But was not ready to spend more than about 22K after exchange. But phone prices had got very expensive. Considered the Galaxy S10 lite for a while, but when it finally came down to sub 25K price point post exchange, it was already a bit dated as it had the Snapdragon 855 processor only. Looked at Oneplus 9R but that was also expensive at close to 40K. Nearly bought the redmi note 10 pro a few months ago, but decided not to as it was in reality an early 2020 phone. When Mi 11X launched, I was excited and had trouble to hold on for a good sale price. Finally the Prime day happened and I could not believe the kind of price point I managed to buy this phone at! It was on sale at 28K and there was an extra 5000 Rupees off on exchange. I got 10,600 in total for the Galaxy phone, when the local dealer would not even offer 4K. Plus, there was the HDFC Cards deal of Rs. 1250 and net net I got the phone for about 16,200 Rupees!!! The phone is a delight. The screen is large and display quality is just amazing with the Amoled panel. Absolutely zero reflection and very fine tune-able brightness. The camera quality is OK, and can resolve long shots with a lot of detail. Macro sensor is great and near range shots are brilliant. See attached photos. The phone feels light for such a large device! I got the Giftkart case recommended by Amazon and it is light also and does not add any heft. The case is grippy too. The battery life surprised me. With very light use it goes for 2 days and with moderate use for 1.5 days. It fast-charges to full in less than an hour. I keep getting various Mi pop-ups but I am slowly disabling each and they are less and less now after 3 days. Sound is decent though not as good as my iPhone xR. Overall really kicked at this value Buy! Thank you, Amazon! ****Update after 2.5 months **** Still doing great! The display is what I enjoy most. It is really vibrant. Sound quality through my one plus z-bass ear band is simply awesome! The battery seems to be slowing down a little already and I am apprehensive that it may not last more than a year. Otherwise no problems whatsoever! Be careful of popular screen protector and case combinations in Amazon. I had to throw out the protector as the case was too tight.

      • bigshopper
        5 out of 5 stars
        A great value buy, especially on Prime Day!
        Reviewed in India on 29 July 2021
        Colour: Celestial SilverSize: 6GB RAM 128GB Storage
        Verified Purchase
        Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
        Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

        I got this phone after using the Samsung Galaxy S9 Plus for nearly 3.5 years. That phone had a battery that was draining fast and also developed a tiny spot on one edge of the screen. I wanted a near-flagship level phone since I was used to the great performance on the S9 plus. But was not ready to spend more than about 22K after exchange.

        But phone prices had got very expensive. Considered the Galaxy S10 lite for a while, but when it finally came down to sub 25K price point post exchange, it was already a bit dated as it had the Snapdragon 855 processor only. Looked at Oneplus 9R but that was also expensive at close to 40K.

        Nearly bought the redmi note 10 pro a few months ago, but decided not to as it was in reality an early 2020 phone. When Mi 11X launched, I was excited and had trouble to hold on for a good sale price. Finally the Prime day happened and I could not believe the kind of price point I managed to buy this phone at!

        It was on sale at 28K and there was an extra 5000 Rupees off on exchange. I got 10,600 in total for the Galaxy phone, when the local dealer would not even offer 4K. Plus, there was the HDFC Cards deal of Rs. 1250 and net net I got the phone for about 16,200 Rupees!!!

        The phone is a delight. The screen is large and display quality is just amazing with the Amoled panel. Absolutely zero reflection and very fine tune-able brightness. The camera quality is OK, and can resolve long shots with a lot of detail. Macro sensor is great and near range shots are brilliant. See attached photos.

        The phone feels light for such a large device! I got the Giftkart case recommended by Amazon and it is light also and does not add any heft. The case is grippy too.

        The battery life surprised me. With very light use it goes for 2 days and with moderate use for 1.5 days. It fast-charges to full in less than an hour.

        I keep getting various Mi pop-ups but I am slowly disabling each and they are less and less now after 3 days. Sound is decent though not as good as my iPhone xR.

        Overall really kicked at this value Buy! Thank you, Amazon!

        ****Update after 2.5 months ****

        Still doing great! The display is what I enjoy most. It is really vibrant. Sound quality through my one plus z-bass ear band is simply awesome! The battery seems to be slowing down a little already and I am apprehensive that it may not last more than a year. Otherwise no problems whatsoever!

        Be careful of popular screen protector and case combinations in Amazon. I had to throw out the protector as the case was too tight.

        4 out of 5 stars
        Phone is good but has heating issues.
        Reviewed in India on 7 September 2021
        Verified Purchase
        Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
        Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

        So I am using this phone since a month or so and ready to give my review. I have purchased 8gb/128gb version for it's processor and clock speed of 3.2ghz and boy, it doesn't disappoint me.

        1. Phone is excellent in multitasking.

        2. Pubg lovers will surely love this phone for it's capability

        to handle the game smoothly.

        3. Camera is average. I believe xiaomi might have done a

        better job with camera in this price range. Though Macro

        shots are good. But if you are looking for a camera

        phone, my advice : go for some other phones.

        4. This is my first side mounted fingerprint sensor phone

        and it should be the last as well. It's a pain in the arch to

        use side mounted fingerprint if you depend only 1 finger

        to unlock your phone.

        5. Battery performance is ok. Though I am working from

        home so I don't have to worry about the charge but the

        charge is decent and can last almost 24 hours on

        moderate use.

        6. Display brightness is also good and you can use it even

        under the sunlight for normal tasks.

        7. Inclusion of C-type headphones is nothing but an

        strategy to make users purchase a bluetooth headphone

        'cause you can't use your headphone and charge your

        phone at the same time.

        8. A little heavy for a continuous use. And when I say heavy,

        I am referring to the weight of the phone

        So I am using this phone since a month or so and ready to give my review. I have purchased 8gb/128gb version for it's processor and clock speed of 3.2ghz and boy, it doesn't disappoint me.

        1. Phone is excellent in multitasking.

        2. Pubg lovers will surely love this phone for it's capability

        to handle the game smoothly.

        3. Camera is average. I believe xiaomi might have done a

        better job with camera in this price range. Though Macro

        shots are good. But if you are looking for a camera

        phone, my advice : go for some other phones.

        4. This is my first side mounted fingerprint sensor phone

        and it should be the last as well. It's a pain in the arch to

        use side mounted fingerprint if you depend only 1 finger

        to unlock your phone.

        5. Battery performance is ok. Though I am working from

        home so I don't have to worry about the charge but the

        charge is decent and can last almost 24 hours on

        moderate use.

        6. Display brightness is also good and you can use it even

        under the sunlight for normal tasks.

        7. Inclusion of C-type headphones is nothing but an

        strategy to make users purchase a bluetooth headphone

        'cause you can't use your headphone and charge your

        phone at the same time.

        8. A little heavy for a continuous use. And when I say heavy,

        I am referring to the weight of the phone

        Overall it's a good phone and added benefits for prime member of free screen replacement hoti 6 months makes it better.

        5 out of 5 stars
        (24 Hours usage Review) Will update the review later.
        Reviewed in India on 20 June 2021
        Verified Purchase
        Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
        Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

        Finally got hands on this device after waiting so long. So first of all, This phone can be called an excellent all-rounder overall. Tested everything possible in my day 1 with this phone. There were much pros but still some cons. So here it is.

        (Pros)

        1-Although i got the Celestial Silver, the in hand feeling was awesome the design is too good, very lightweight (without cover) The side mounted fingerprint scanner is very responsive.

        2- The E4 Amoled panel is just awesome. For the purpose of multimedia this display is excellent, The colour intensity is balanced, display is bright too. The touch response is also good so in both 120 and 60hz refresh rate.

        3-Performance wise i would say this is a beast in my first antutu benchmark it scored 670000 which is a very good score obviously. Checked many games like Asphalt 9, Battlegrounds Mobile and Pes2021 in highest graphics and it handled very amazingly. I monited the FPS with an external FPS meter too and it managed 55-60 fps always in BGMI sometimes very rarely it dropped to 45-50

        3-Connectivity is also good I tested Vi Sim and 100mps wifi speed and it was giving very good speed too.

        4-Camera has loads of features to check out although the primary sensor is 48mp which is decent but the Macro shooter is very good. Front Camera is also more than decent it maintains the exposure very well.

        5-Battery charging- I got the phone with 49% battery with everything enabled like AOD and Screen blink notifications, 5G enabled. Due to all this the battery was little bit draining fast but will test it more. Charginh speed is just awesome it took 52minutes to charge up from 0 to 100% in my very first test.

        6-The Miui 12.5 is little improved too and has very unique features, themes to explore. Will test soon.

        (Cons)

        1- In my very first use the battery drained really fast i charged it later for the first time and now getting slightly better battery backup after turning off major features like AOD, 5G but still i will test the draining after charging it 2-3 times more.

        2-If You want a phone just for Camera purpose and mainly for rear camera then I would not recommend it cuz it doesn't have OIS which should be there and the 48mp primary sensor ain't that much good.

        3-Ram management has to be improved a lot you may found some minor ram diff between 6GB and 8GB varient so choose wisely.

        4-The display is very good but in the case of Peak brightness i didn't found it much bright but yes you can use it in sunlight without any issues.

        (Will update each and everything after using and testing it more)

      • Abhigyan d.
        5 out of 5 stars
        GREAT DEVICE BUT...
        Reviewed in India on 27 May 2021
        Colour: Celestial SilverSize: 6GB RAM 128GB Storage
        Verified Purchase
        Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
        Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

        Hi!

        I bought it at 28k(during the coupon offer period) and it's been 1 week sincce i bought it and now i have discovered many things about this phone, so read below for the full review...👇

        PROS:-

        1) It's design- i bought the silver one and believe me it's the best among the all colours (becoz black is glossy and fingerprints are easily visible and white is very decent not much attractive) it is very light but it feels a little bigger in hand and it is slim too.

        2) Performance:- it can handle normal tasks without a single issue, it is very responsive, i compared it with oneplus 7pro side by side and it was more responsive than the 1+.

        Display:-it is very smooth and the quality is awesome. NOT a single issue till now (except two i will talk about it in cons section)

        Speakers:- they are very loud even louder than the oneplus 7 pro and have good base too.

        Haptics:-they are good but on the first day it was making a sparkling sound but that got fixed by their own.

        Selfie camera:- it performs very good in daylight and when their is enough light but it sucks in low light. I would prefer to use the gcam.

        Macro camera:- it isn't like the 2mp camera which brands give just for numbers. It's a true macro camera, it can go very close and gives a clear photos

        Camera options:- they have given a lot of options in the camera app. Video recording option is available in every camera lens on this phone.

        Gcam photos- I didn't like the stock camera but the images on the gcam are really different, they have better dynamic range , better resolution and so on...low light photos are also better in gcam

        CONS:-

        Low light photography:- the camera doesn't performs well in low light, ut performs like a 15k device

        Miui:- this is the main thing which is holding it back to become the true flagship killer. It isn't optimised completely, i found bugs on the second of usage only...

        Gaming:- though it can handle pubg in smooth+extreme very easily but if you are buying it for competitive then it will not met your expectations

        But Yeah Xiaomi can fix theses issue by improving their ui.

        Overall camera:- they are not as good as other 30k phone(it doesn't have 4k 60 and ois too) but in daylight or in some condition it performs very very good

        Fingerprint reader:- it has the side mounted fingerprint sensor I don't like it, i was expecting an in display fingerprint sensor, it looks vey premium! as compared to side mounted

        So the verdict is that if you need a decent camera, great performance for casual gaming and a very great quality display then you can go for it

        Many people are going for iqoo 7,

        It's a very good device but still I won't prefer you to buy (it's my personal opinion don't take it seriously)

        I will upload some sample shots later soon

        Thanks!

        And wear a mask

        ✌️🤘

      • Placeholder
        3 out of 5 stars
        Tarrific performance, terrible camera
        Reviewed in India on 20 June 2021
        Verified Purchase
        Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
        Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

        I have switched to this device from POCO F1 which I also bought on 1st day of launch. i.e. completing quarter to three years with that device. Since then my priorities haven't been changed much - flagship performance and value for money. All things come second to that.

        I missed the most in POCO F1:

            - lack of good, bright display(was an LCD one)

           - Stereo speakers(Poco claim is the pseudo one)

             - and although the phone was one of the fastest of that time, it felt slow to me after a year.

             - the intuitiveness of notification badges (coming from stock android phone)

        The camera was just according to the 23k price for POCO F1.

        I have been always a fan of stock android but settled to MIUI because oneplus is no longer the oneplus we knew, and over these years I got used to some features that are not natively supported by stock android without rooting the device, like native call recording, native app lock that cannot be uninstalled, native dual app support for all the apps. And now somehow these features became a necessity for me. Still, if Oneplus would offer the same value as MI, surely I would have opted for Oneplus but that will not be going to be the case in future too.

        So priorities for buying were AMOLED display with 90/120Hz refresh rate, stereo speakers, flagship-level processor

        So talking first of 

        --------------------------

        Design/ Hardware -

        --------------------------

        I do not care much about the back of the phone, as long as I use a back cover, SO any colour is fine, don't care much about the rest, camera bumps are everywhere so no complaints.

        -I want narrow bezels: present.

        -I prefer capacitive fingerprint reader over optical one: present

        -I prefer metal/plastic back to a glass one: not present

        -I want headphone jack BADLY: NOT present

        -I prefer IR face scan over camera-based: not present

        Hole punch is generic, and doesn't cover more than needed space.

        It has Wifi6 which is appreciable.

        It uses Corning's Gorilla Glass 5 which is one generation older, but it's okay.

        It has touch sampling tech, but I am not an FPS gamer.

        I don't know why Mi doesn't give NFC in Indian phones, as if adding it would be costly, Hey MI we Indians want NFC, okay?

        ------------

        Display -

        ------------

        Sure I feel upgraded after switching from an LCD. clearly, I can see the deeper black on that super bright 900nits max brightness display. Apart from it being tall from the wider POCO F1, it is also 0.5" larger at 6.67". Its aspect ratio is at the taller side i.e. 20:9. while most content is shot in 16:9 which is a little bit taller(landscape). Making such a big phone wider would have made it not easy to handle it but I would have managed it because for me the big screen is of no use If my media(mostly youtube and movies) are in the same area as in a phone of shorter screen size.

        Again movies in cinematic resolution work well for this screen, Screen is a pro for the latter and a con for the former, I am a balance out of both screens seeking consumer.

        The second thing is the 120Hz refresh rate, most people would not bother about it. But once I switched to it and whenever I used POCO again at 60Hz I clearly felt that downgrade although it is not a biggie but once you stick to it, you may not want to go to 60Hz again. As of now, Mi 11x doesn't support variable refresh rates so the battery may discharge a bit faster, because there are some apps where 120Hz is not supported or needed, variable refresh rate could be handy in those cases, however, it may come via OTA update in future.

        Lastly, sunlight brightness is too good, peeking at 1300nits.

        The display is for sure a flagship one.

        ------------------

        Performance -

        ------------------

        It has snapdragon 870. The only thing that lured me initially. performance is excellent, top-notch.

        -----------

        Camera- 

        -----------

        After being in the work domain my camera uses has reduced a lot, I capture very few photos these days. So the camera wasn't my priority, And even if the camera was my priority I would not have got near-flagship camera performance in that budget.

        Rear Cameras Image quality is below average at best. Many times I felt a downgrade in details while comparing images captured from POCO. Instead of macro, I would have liked a telephoto lens. Images on zooming(in gallery) clearly shows how pathetic level has been achieved. Lens level 2x zoom is bearable.

        The front camera is also average.

        Behind ditching Mi 11x Pro there was a reason because 1. It doesn't offer the real upgrade over the 11x in camera performance, increasing megapixel would not be considered an upgrade if image quality is not improved. 2. neither 11x or 11x pro offer OIS.

        I also don't care about 4K recording because it uses a big chunk of space, for me 60fps1080p is fine.

        --------------

        Software -

        --------------

        I hate any other UI that is not near stock till date, so the first app I install on my new phone is Nova launcher(prime) and I am good to go. Half the trouble goes after that. For the rest of the troubles, I have to make myself accustomed like I can't change how notifications appear in MiUI. At least I want to change the response button of notifications to be bigger like in stock android.

        The second thing is notification badges don't give the same feel as in stock android.

        Non-uninstallable bloatware is also an issue, but I have managed to ignore this by hiding bloatware from app-drawer, disabling notification from all non-removable unwanted apps etc.

        As of now current MiUI on it is super buggy. Like gestures don't work on the nova launcher, music playback notification doesn't go away etc. The system-wide dark mode also blacks some major information on some apps, so it's not perfect.

        Widevine L1 certification is present, also supports HDR10.

        what I really like about the 11x software is

        1. grains and fade in reading/night/blue-light filter-mode, such a good retro feel is achieved by this unique software feature.

        2. Always-on display is there, but unlike moto phone, it is not interactive

        3. Haptic feedback is decent

        Being in a work environment I sometimes have to record calls, It was easy on POCO, now in Mi 11x phone and message apps are replaced by google's phone and message apps. I am a fan of both but auto call recording now started by a computer disclaimer which the other person will also hear "this call is being recorded"; bruh, disabled.

        One issue which is prominent is the location of the proximity sensor, it is not placed right and many, many time you will be muting, holding, putting on speaker your call inadvertently.

        I like to keep my app-lock and lock screen pattern different so native app lock is welcomed.

        ----------

        Sound-

        ----------

        It has stereo speakers, which are true stereo, loud and clear. I am happy with the loudness of the speakers as long as they won't get crackled in future.

        Hi-res certified and headphone output is decent, loud, typical non-DAC output. Although it supports Dolby Atmos for smartphones.

        Earpiece speaker output is quite good, loud, clear, just it that you have to habituate yourself to keep your ear at a particular point of the phone for that.

        -----------

        Battery-

        -----------

        The battery is decent enough to last a day, with no sudden drops in battery level. Overnight juice theft is low. No problems in battery dept.

        Comes with support of 33W charging max, which is fine but considering competition 50W could have been better.

        It charges to full in nearly one hour generally.

        --------

        Pros- 

        --------

        -Performance; gap in performance to snapdragon 888 is slim and would be fine for most.

        -Great AMOLED display, brightness is nitty.

        - Super stereo speakers, sufficiently loud

        -Good battery life, 33W charging

        -Personally liked MiUI's Night mode grains and fade feature

        -Physical fingerprint reader

        -good sound output

        - Excellent Value for money 

        ---------

        Cons-

        ---------

        - Below average camera. Boo! Have it been at least above average, this star phone could have been a superstar

        - Auto call recording is ruined (3rd party is never as good as a native feature, also paid)

        - Software is buggy as of now

        - No headphone jack

        - Indian version doesn't have NFC (why Mi?)

        Well, Mi11x is for sure a value for money device, ensure near-flagship performance has flagship-level display and sound.

        Given its below-average camera, it is most suited for working professionals, gamers on budget and all pro-performance people(like me). 

        Overall ★★★

        Thank You!

        4 out of 5 stars
        Good, with some problems
        Reviewed in India on 11 September 2021
        Colour: Celestial SilverSize: 6GB RAM 128GB Storage
        Verified Purchase
        Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
        Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

        I am writing this review after using the phone for more than six weeks. My usage is almost entirely browsing or watching videos on Netflix, prime, hotstar etc. I use the phone for 3-6 hrs daily. Here's my review:

        Good:

        1. Charging speed is amazing. It gets charged to 100% in no time.

        2. Camera quality is great. I had people asking me how I was taking the pics I post.

        3. Build quality is nice. Not too heavy, not too light. It's just perfect.

        4. I never found the phone hanging or struggling. May be because I don't play games, so not sure how well it can handle high performance apps.

        Cons:

        1. Software bugs: one of my biggest pinpoint is that the phone asks me to enter password once every hr. It should have been 72 hrs as per forums but my device seems to have a bug. Their solution is to reformat. I am yet to do as that's a headache taking backup and reformatting.

        2. Battery backup: battery drains so fast. Their fast charging is a savior but if we are outside for long time I believe this is going to be a big problem.

        3. Scroll feature is missing on fingerprint scanner. I have been using that a lot on my prev m51, that i find it to be very useful. Would have loved to have it.

        Overall, this is a decent phone with good build quality. But it has some problems that shouldn't have been on a phone at 30k price point.

        Don't even think of buying this phone

        Reviewed in India on 2 July 2021

        The very first issue I noticed on this mobile within 24 of purchase is flickering display. You will not know when it will come or why does that come but when starts you will not be able to operate the phone you need to restart the phone.

        2nd issue the fingerprint scanner will not respond at times you need to scan your finger multiple times to unlock the phone.

        3rd issue this an awesome feature the notifications bar automatically come down at times keeping you disturbed when you are something else.

        4th issue- one more awesome feature, when you are on call all of sudden you won't be able to hear the other person's voice it will go completely mute.

        5th- the double tab function is malfunctioning.

        6th- this not about the phone but it was the most pathetic among all the issues I have faced since I bought this mobile- this is about how the Amazon customer support team is working. For the replacement I had to contact the support team around 5-6 times and ever time I place a call request some new guy will use to call me and had to explain the whole story from the scratch because the previous agent will assure you that they gonna help you with your issue but they will not update even a single sentence in their system. It was really Irritating and very much frustrating however at the end you won't get any kind of help from them and you must travel to you initial shipping address for the replacement. Suppose it's new order instead of replacement request and if you request them to deliver it to a different address then definitely they gonna get it delivered because somehow they want to sell their products... With this kinda approach you might be able to generate new customers but when you don't provide services or at least proper response to the customers then eventually you will be loosing the old customers and finally one day you gonna close your business because you will be left with no customers because you lost their trust.

        The customer support agent are dumb at solving the customers issue but they are genius at hanging up the calls. They use all sort of tricks to hang up the calls.

        Well finally I have get it replaced but the thing is I have noticed the same flickering issue in this phone as well. Now again I have to try all the trouble shooting steps on this one as well to see if that's gonna work or not. What's worrying me now is what if that doesn't work as well???

        Just imagine if I'm writing such a long feedback taking so much of time then how much time I might have spent in contacting the support team... I request all the buyers please don't buy this particular phone this was my very first MI phone and I'm going through a great experience... Well I will update after 24 or 48 hours and tell you whether the troubleshooting steps worked or not... Moreover I will upload the display flickering video as well
